Lemma
[tensoriality of the curvature tensor]

Source: petersen:page-0096 ↗ def:pet-ch3-curvature-tensor

For $f\in C^\infty (M)$, $R(X,Y)(fZ)=fR(X,Y)Z$.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch3-curvature-tensor-tensorial

\sketch The product rule gives

\[ R(X,Y)(fZ)=fR(X,Y)Z+ igl( abla ^2_{X,Y}f- abla ^2_{Y,X}f igr)Z. \]

The final term vanishes because the Hessian of a function is symmetric.

□
